database_name: ArtVision Miami Art Week Exhibition Opportunities
description: Searchable database of free (and select prestigious fee) opportunities to exhibit digital or physical art during Miami Art Week 2026. Focus on clear deadlines, no/low cost, Web3/crypto related. For ArtVision podcast. Search by keyword (e.g. MIAMI) + status open.

opportunities.title: One Love Art DAO Flash Open Call: GTA VI Vice City Inspired Art
opportunities.event_dates: Miami Art Week Nov 30 – Dec 6, 2026 (exhibition during the week at YVE Hotel)
opportunities.location: One Love Gallery, YVE Hotel Miami, 146 Biscayne Blvd, Miami, FL
opportunities.what_looking_for: GTA VI / Vice City inspired digital artwork. Horizontal aspect ratio 3840x2160. Minted or unminted. Fun community showcase.
opportunities.fee: Free to apply and free to exhibit
opportunities.receipts_details: Post one piece of art (image, video, or link) as a reply under the official X post
opportunities.includes_entry: Yes – selected work is exhibited in the gallery during Miami Art Week; artists can visit the space
opportunities.google_or_search: OneLoveArtDAO GTA VI open call OR HotelYve Miami Art Week flash call
opportunities.organization: One Love Art DAO (non-profit 501c3) in partnership with HotelYve and N3XTCULTURE
opportunities.notes: Super low barrier. Reply on X. Encouraging community vibe. Perfect for digital/Web3 artists.

opportunities.title: CONTEXT Art Miami Artist Selection & Representation (Nova Gallery)
opportunities.event_dates: CONTEXT Art Miami Dec 1–6, 2026 (and online via Artsy)
opportunities.location: CONTEXT Art Miami fair + online Artsy exhibition
opportunities.what_looking_for: Visual artists worldwide, any contemporary medium (painting, digital, sculpture, photo, etc.). Strong work suitable for collectors.
opportunities.fee_reason: Covers professional selection process; selected artists receive Artsy online exhibition, press release to 75k+ contacts, collector/advisory exposure, 70% of net sales, and possible 12-month non-exclusive gallery representation. Prestigious satellite fair exposure.
opportunities.application_questions: Form-based (exact count not public; includes standard artist info)
opportunities.receipts_details: Up to 5 images of work through the application form. Likely bio/statement as well.
opportunities.includes_entry: Yes for selected – exhibition at/through the fair and online; potential representation.
opportunities.google_or_search: CONTEXT Art Miami artist selection Nova Gallery open call
opportunities.organization: Nova Gallery / CONTEXT Art Miami related
opportunities.notes: Include because prestigious fair and representation upside. Verify full guidelines on official site before applying.

opportunities.title: One Love Art DAO FRONTERA Open Call
opportunities.event_dates: Miami Art Week Nov 30 – Dec 6, 2026 at YVE Hotel gallery
opportunities.location: One Love Gallery, YVE Hotel Miami
opportunities.what_looking_for: Works that challenge understanding and shift perspectives. Digital and physical.
opportunities.application_questions: Google Form (details varied; included artist info and work)
opportunities.receipts_details: Submit via Google Form (link was in X post)
opportunities.notes: Closed and under curatorial review. Example of previous free DAO call. Keep in database for history.
